description: This Java source file defines an interface 'Scenario4MultipleSubjects' which extends the 'Scenario' interface, representing a specific scenario involving multiple subjects and policy definitions for testing purposes within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains definitions of subject identifiers, a complex static Policy object built using a factory pattern, and default methods to retrieve the policy, scenario group name, and an application algorithm function.

classes.name: Scenario4MultipleSubjects
classes.description: An interface representing a specific test scenario involving multiple subjects and associated policies within the Eclipse Ditto testing framework.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the predefined Policy object that encapsulates subject permissions and labels for the scenario.

methods.name: getScenarioGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the scenario group, used for grouping related scenarios in testing.

methods.name: getApplyAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Returns a function that applies a PolicyAlgorithm to check permissions on the scenario's setup.
